chars.M: MOUAD: a slim young Moroccan man of about 22 wearing a navy zip hoodie with white drawstrings, light blue jeans and white sneakers.
chars.A: KHALTI: a cheerful Moroccan woman of about 42 wearing a long mustard-yellow tunic over black trousers, a burgundy headscarf, gold bangles and a small brown handbag.
chars.S: OLD MAN: an old Moroccan man in a grey djellaba, a white knitted taqiya cap and a short white beard, holding a key ring.

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: Inside a modest Moroccan living room with low sofas. KHALTI stands mid-gesture, leaning toward MOUAD with a big excited smile, one hand pointing toward the window as if proposing a trip, her face clearly visible, head-to-waist framing. MOUAD sits on the sofa, surprised, eyebrows raised. Seen from the doorway.

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: A Moroccan bedroom: KHALTI happily folding colourful clothes into an open suitcase on the bed, a beach hat and sunglasses beside it, beaming with joy, face visible, head-to-waist framing.

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: Inside a small old car on a sunny coastal road in Morocco, seen through the windshield: MOUAD driving, KHALTI in the passenger seat laughing with her arm out of the window, the blue sea visible on one side.

scenes.name: n4.png
scenes.scene: A small sunny Moroccan seaside town street with white and blue houses: MOUAD scratches his head, worried, asking around, KHALTI next to him holding her suitcase handle, looking around with a playful smile.

scenes.name: n5.png
scenes.scene: On the same seaside street, the OLD MAN talks to MOUAD and dangles a key, pointing down a narrow lane; MOUAD listens, KHALTI behind him nodding eagerly.

scenes.name: n6.png
scenes.scene: In front of a tiny whitewashed one-storey house with a blue door, plain cement walls, very clean: the OLD MAN opens the blue door, MOUAD and KHALTI peek inside, KHALTI pleased.

scenes.name: n7.png
scenes.scene: Inside the tiny house's small salon with a simple Moroccan sofa: MOUAD puts their bags down and counts three fingers on his hand, KHALTI already relaxing on the sofa, smiling at him.

scenes.name: n8.png
scenes.scene: Inside the tiny house: MOUAD stands in the middle of the small salon looking at the camera with an awkward, uneasy expression, while KHALTI behind him adjusts her headscarf in a small mirror, calm and smiling.

scenes.name: n9.png
scenes.scene: Seen from the hallway: MOUAD and KHALTI standing in the doorway of the only small bedroom of the tiny house, which has a single bed with a blue blanket. MOUAD looks at the bed, then at her, nervous and sweating; KHALTI looks at him with a calm mysterious smile. Fully clothed, nothing suggestive.
